preregistration.data: Exact previous repaired 600 TRAIN tiles, original Pimple only; reviewed Mole objects; pseudo positives and surroundings UNKNOWN
preregistration.graph: Original model has shared reg_convs, no obj_convs. Clone reg_convs into obj_convs initialized identically, route only obj_preds through copy; shared stems frozen
frozen: all BN affine parameters and statistics
preregistration.prefitRequired: Each of five objects has nonzero allowed negatives, normalized negative loss and gradients to objectness feature/prediction weights; original positives protected; Step0 output parity before fitting
preregistration.trainSuccess: All five fixed-source object max obj*cls <0.30, retain all Step0 matched original Pimple targets on fixed 10-group TRAIN probes and five object tiles; no box/class/BN change
preregistration.continuation: No long run if known TRAIN mistakes remain. TRAIN success is not generalization. Freeze at <=150 then evaluate same 28 controls and Scope B; require no source-target loss and fewer reviewed-negative FP vs Step0
preregistration.earlyStop: Safety only: missing label/gradient path, changed frozen state, nonfinite or resource failure; preserve complete checkpoints
preregistration.comparability: Same Step0/data/order/LR/schedule/loss/clip as prior repaired objectness-only arm. Additional feature parameters, backward work and global clip scaling differ; not a causal proof about all backbone features
